## About
Fettes, Love & Sieben was founded by James Fettes, William Love and Philip Sieben. Mr. Fettes and Mr. Love were Plumbing Foremen for Noble & Thum Plumbing Company, and Mr. Sieben was an accountant from the Sieben Brewery Family.
Today we're a plumbing and heating contractor on N Lincoln Avenue in Chicago. Our crew includes Plumbers, Pipe-Fitters, Laborers and Operating Engineers.
Our service department handles residential and commercial service and maintenance, from single family homes to high rises and mid-rises. Our contract division takes on high-end residential, commercial, healthcare, riser replacement, industrial and design build work.

## Services
- Residential service and remodel: Service, maintenance and remodel work for houses, condos and apartments.
- Commercial service and remodel: Service, maintenance and remodel work for commercial buildings, including high rises and mid-rises.
- Healthcare: Plumbing and heating contract work for healthcare projects.
- Riser replacement: Contract work, typically bid to general contractors.
- Design build: Contract work for industrial and design build projects.
- Water heater installation: One family wrote in after Chuck installed their water heater.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work in houses or big buildings?
A: Both. Our service plumbers work in Chicago high rises and mid-rises and in single family homes throughout the suburbs.

Q: Can I get a free estimate?
A: Yes. No project is too large or too small. If you'd like a free estimate, please contact us.
